digest.component_or_area: DC sync: outbound parent emit, inbound parent mirror
propositions: A non-epic parent on a Jira DC sub-task is accepted by REST but silently ignored; the platform does not support reparenting sub-tasks.
When rebar suppresses a non-epic parent emit (because the tracker cannot represent it), the pass exits 0 and reports convergence with no durable operator-visible record of the divergence.
_resolve_local_parent returns (False, None) for a non-epic parent and for an unbound parent indistinguishably, making the emit suppression structurally unreachable to the bridge_alerts apparatus.

The three failing cells were wrong oracles asserting operations the platform cannot perform; re-homing them to epic-link reparents preserves the user-visible contract while removing impossible setups.
The emit-time suppression must become loud via a dropped-field alert without lifting the guard that prevents writes DC would ignore.
Live harness run 30964805133 verified all three re-homed cells pass end-to-end on epic-link mechanism, and the platform limit on sub-task reparenting stays pinned by separate refusal cells.
